cues.en: Mathers, son of Deuteronomy of Gath. Do I say yes? Yes. Yes. You have been found guilty by the elders of the town of uttering the name of our lord,
cues.zh: 马瑟斯，迦特的多特罗诺米之子。我说是了吗？是的。是的。你已被镇上长老判定有罪，因你妄称我主之名，

cues.en: and so as a blasphemer.
You are to be stoned to death. Look,
I'd had a lovely supper, and all I said to my wife was that piece of halibut was good enough for Jehovah.
cues.zh: 我吃了顿美味的晚餐，我只对我妻子说那块大比目鱼够配耶和华了。

cues.en: Yes, for me. He said it again. Yes, he did. Did you hear him? Yes, he
cues.zh: 是的，对我来说。他又说了。是的，他说了。你听到了吗？是的，他

cues.en: did.
Are there any women here today?
Very well. By virtue of the authority
cues.zh: 很好。凭借赋予我的权力

cues.en: vested in me Oh,
lay off. We haven't started yet. Come on. Who threw that?
cues.zh: 别闹了。我们还没开始呢。来吧，谁扔的？

cues.en: Who threw that stone? Come on.
Sorry. I thought we started.
Go to the back.
Oh, dear. Always one, isn't there?
cues.zh: 哎呀，总有这么一个人，是吧？

cues.en: Now, where were we? Look, I don't think it ought to be blasphemy.
cues.zh: 我们刚才说到哪儿了？听着，我不觉得这算亵渎。

cues.en: Just saying, Jehovah. You're
cues.zh: 只是说了一句“耶和华”。你这是

cues.en: only making it worse for yourself. Making it worse. How could it be worse?
cues.zh: 越说越糟。越描越黑。还能糟到哪儿去？

cues.en: Jehovah.
Jehovah.
I'm warning you. If you say Jehovah once more, strike.
cues.zh: 我警告你们，要是再敢说一次“耶和华”，就动手。

cues.en: Who threw that?
Come
on. Now look. No one
is to stone anyone
until I blow this whistle. Do you understand?
cues.zh: 直到我吹哨为止，听明白了吗？

cues.en: Even... And I wanna make this absolutely clear.
cues.zh: 即便……我得把话彻底说清楚，

cues.en: Even if they do say Jehovah.
cues.zh: 即便他们真的说了“耶和华”也不行。
